tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and slide background.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Panels, table headers, callout boxes, alternate slide background.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table borders, dividers.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on surface and surface-alt. In light theme this is SovLab Navy.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, footers, metadata. Passes 4.5:1 on surface and surface-alt in both themes.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: SovLab Navy, the primary brand color. Use for dark slides, title slides and solid blocks. Same value in both themes.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: SovLab Green, the accent. Fills, the logo dot, chart highlights, bullets. Not for text on white (2.6:1).

tokens.name: green-text
tokens.usage: Green when it has to be text: links, highlighted words. 5.4:1 on white, 9.4:1 on navy.

tokens.name: green-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind green-text, for callouts and tags.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a green fill. Navy, never white (white on green is 2.6:1).

tokens.name: green-strong
tokens.usage: Green for marks that must stand out on white without being text: chart main series, progress, status dots. 3.6:1 on white.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, failed states, destructive actions. Text or fill. 5.6:1 on white.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind danger text: error callouts, failed badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings and degraded states. Text or icon. 5.5:1 on white.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind warning text.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information, in-progress states, informational badges. 6.4:1 on white.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind info text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success and healthy states. Same value as green-text.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind success text, selected rows, active navigation.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Fourth chart series only. Not a status color.

groups.name: Slides
groups.note: 16:9 slides at 1920 x 1080. Scale proportionally for smaller canvases.

styles.name: slide-body
styles.sample: Mail, chat and identity run on servers you control.
styles.usage: Bullets and short paragraphs. Five bullets max.

groups.name: Documents
groups.note: Letter or A4 pages, and on-screen docs.

styles.name: doc-body
styles.sample: We moved 240 mailboxes off a hosted provider in six weeks.
styles.usage: Running text. Use 11pt in Word or Google Docs.

styles.name: doc-caption
styles.usage: Captions, table labels, footers, in ink-muted. Use 9pt in Word or Google Docs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Padding inside callouts and table cells.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between paragraphs and blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections; minimum logo clear space at 1000px width.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Slide margins at 1920 x 1080.

radius.note: Rounded, never pill-shaped. Matches the rounded bracket ends.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Callouts, cards, images in slides.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large blocks and panels.
